D/ (ANT]ONINVS AVG PIVS PP ; R/ TRP COS II

Silver coin. Denarius of Antoninus Pius (138-161), mint of Rome, RIC vol. 3 page 31 no. 45, issue of 139. Obverse description: Bust right, bearded. Obverse inscription: (ANT]ONINVS AVG PIVS PP. Reverse description: Sacrificial implements. Reverse inscription: TRP COS II. Diameter: 18.2mm, Weight: 2.72gms, die axis: 6
